_comment: Example pack filter.json — PACK CONTENT, pinned by the topic's experiment_pack_digest, never compiled into the adaptor. Every name is a placeholder. `slices` map a signed constraints.task_slice label onto task directory names (a slices/<label>.json or .txt file works too); `allow` is the pack's default set when the topic names neither `tasks` nor a slice; `deny` is always removed; `max_duration_s` may only lower a topic's max_task_duration_s and is inert without one; `durations` are measured walls in seconds used by that gate.
